label: q35-4b-rapidmlx
version_cmd: import importlib.metadata as m; print(*(n + ' ' + m.version(n) for n in ('rapid-mlx', 'mlx', 'mlx-lm', 'mlx-vlm')))
note: Rapid-MLX 0.16.3 (the latest release; RAPID_MLX_BIN = its venv's rapid-mlx, mlx 0.32.4, mlx-lm 0.31.3, mlx-vlm 0.7.2) serving the same MLX 4-bit folder every engine reads, by path (lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit @c43ee1d; Rapid-MLX's own alias qwen3.5-4b-4bit points at mlx-community's upload of the same conversion). The settings its catalog gives the alias (rapid-mlx info qwen3.5-4b-4bit): 512-token prefill steps, the hermes tool parser and the qwen3 reasoning parser (both detected from the folder too); its MTP is opt-in for this model (q35-4b-rapidmlx-mtp). One sequence, 32K context. No telemetry (--no-telemetry, RAPID_MLX_TELEMETRY=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1), no version check, no downloads, no disk caches (--disable-disk-caches: no prefix-cache snapshot or KV checkpoints on disk; the in-memory prefix cache stays on), a fresh HOME per run. Without speculation it serves this vision checkpoint on its multimodal path: 80.4 tok/s at T = 0.6 in short runs, 81.8 with --no-mllm.

label: q35-4b-rapidmlx-mtp
note: As q35-4b-rapidmlx, with MTP: the head its catalog pairs with this model (mlx-community/Qwen3.5-4B-MTP-4bit @ab6f59b, Qwen's own head at 4 bits; mtp_draft_model of the alias), named in --speculative-config. With MTP it serves the text path. 3 draft tokens: fastest in short runs before the session (three sampled decodes each; T = 0.6 tok/s: 3 drafts 101.8, 2 (the alias's mtp_speculative_tokens) 100.7; no speculation 80.4).
